subject.title: fix(mattermost): key private channels as group on outbound routing

question: Should this PR remain proof-blocked until the author posts inspectable redacted session-store or log output for the live private-channel run?
rationale: The code and tests support the intended fix, but the merge-critical claim is stored session namespace state that the screenshot does not visibly prove.

options.title: Require inspectable session proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs, terminal output, or store rows show the patched private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating `channel:<id>`.

options.title: Accept the written proof claim
options.body: A maintainer may deliberately waive the stronger proof gate and merge based on the PR-body table, screenshot, and unit coverage.

options.title: Run maintainer-owned proof
options.body: A maintainer with Mattermost credentials can reproduce the scheduled delivery and inspect the session store independently.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable session proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs, terminal output, or store rows show the patched private-channel delivery reused `group:<id>` without creating `channel:<id>`.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to recent ownership across both Mattermost session routing and cron/session behavior, making this the strongest available proof-sufficiency owner.
